title: observability-control-plane.v1
description: The evaluator and router this repository owns for one environment. Identity and topology only: no product decisions, no secret values.

identity.description: Stable human name of the host, recorded in every promotion receipt.

ssh_alias.description: The alias an operator names when authorizing a promotion. Present so a receipt can record WHICH host was changed; never used to infer a target automatically.

release_root.description: Absolute directory holding immutable release directories. Bind mounts point at a symlink under this root, never at a single file: a single-file bind mount detaches its inode on rename and is why in-place host editing became the only workable path.

external_labels.description: Labels stamped on every series this evaluator owns. An ordered array, not an object, so rendering is deterministic without sorting a mapping.

secrets_dir.description: HOST directory holding secret FILES, mounted read-only into both evaluators. A directory mount, not a file mount. The in-container paths are fixed by the renderer (/etc/prometheus/secrets and /etc/alertmanager/secrets) so a config reference and its mount cannot disagree. This repository names files here; it never holds their contents.

smtp.description: Global SMTP settings. Required whenever any receiver declares an email integration: Alertmanager refuses a config whose email receiver has no smarthost, and the refusal surfaces as a control plane that will not start.

image.description: Image reference WITHOUT a tag-only identity; the digest below is the identity.

version.description: Human-readable version recorded in receipts. Evidence, never the pin.

listen.description: host:port the service binds. Loopback-bound unless a reviewed exception says otherwise.
